_doc: G4 daily GPU-hour budget ledger, recorded per GPU type. Keyed by local date (pick ONE timezone; it defines the midnight reset boundary). gpu_hours = elapsed_hours x n_gpus; gpu_hours_used and gpu_hours_by_type are the sums over the day's jobs. soft_cap_gpu_hours_per_day covers all types; soft_cap_by_type is optional. The decision loop reads remaining-today before any T1 submit; pause T1 when it goes negative. Write atomically (tmp + rename), stdlib-only.
